# RawInputsEnabled

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RawInputsEnabled:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if raw input was asked for, otherwise 0 (the initial value). It says what was asked for, not whether the platform can do it; that is [HWRawInputs](HWRawInputs).

## Description

Tells what [RawInputs](RawInputs) was last set to.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Related Commands

[DirectInputEnabled](DirectInputEnabled), [HWRawInputs](HWRawInputs), [MoveMouse](MoveMouse), [RawInputs](RawInputs)
